sloka: आदित्यम् आहरिष्यामि न मे क्षुत् प्रतियास्यति ।इति सम्चिन्त्य मनसा पुरा एष बल दर्पितः ॥६-२८-१३॥।।
transliteration: ādityam āhariṣyāmi na me kṣut pratiyāsyati ।iti samcintya manasā purā eṣa bala darpitaḥ ॥6-28-13॥।।

translations.english: When he was a child, on seeing the rising Sun, he travelled three thousand yojanas and said, "I will eat up the Sun otherwise I will not be appeased', being proud of his strength."
